svg.title: Web Development — code editor and responsive browser resize
svg.desc: A cursor clicks the original code editor, then drags the output browser's right edge inward. The outlined X image widens from a square toward landscape as the browser grows, and stacked text lines lengthen fluidly. At the shared breakpoint the copy moves beside the image; narrowing reverses the same sequence. The browser height hugs the content and shares a fixed vertical center with the smaller editor throughout resizing. The cursor drags it back to desktop; the editor, arrow, blue surfaces and yellow resize handle keep the development context clear.
